guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, Twilio is initiating a revenue range of $1.595 to $1.605 billion, which implies a reported revenue growth range of 17% to 17.5% and an organic revenue growth range of 11% to 12% year-over-year. Twilio expects fourth quarter non-GAAP gross profit to be similar to its organic revenue growth range. In addition, Twilio is initiating a fourth quarter non-GAAP income from operations range of $300 to $310 million. Lastly, Twilio expects fourth quarter non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in a range of $1.48 to $1.53, based on non-GAAP weighted average diluted shares outstanding of 163 million.

(1) Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share guidance assumes no impact from volatility of foreign exchange rates.

For fiscal year 2026, Twilio is raising its reported revenue growth outlook to 20% compared with 18% to 18.5% previously, and its organic revenue growth range outlook to 15% year-over-year compared with 13% to 13.5% previously. In addition, Twilio expects full-year non-GAAP gross profit growth to be similar to its organic revenue growth range. Lastly, Twilio is raising its 2026 non-GAAP income from operations range to $1.19 billion to $1.20 billion compared to $1.135 billion to $1.155 billion previously, and raising its 2026 free cash flow range to $1.19 billion to $1.20 billion compared to $1.135 billion to $1.155 billion previously.
